Need a place to track my progress in 2016, so here we are.

Plan here is to post once per week, things that work for me, things that don't work for me. If anyone finds this that's fine... but the main point is that I don't feel the need to talk to anyone IRL about this, but I would like to keep a journal. I'm not looking for advice, I know what I need to do. I just need to do it.

Current state: I'm over 40. I weigh 302.9lbs and have 162lbs LBM (estimated off my scale, unknown accuracy). I'm composed of 46.5% fat. BMI is 44.7 and is categorized as "Extremely Obese", otherwise known as "Death Fat".

What's my goal? Looked up healthy body fat ranges and the bare minimum for the "fitness" category is 17%, at 162lbs LMB that says my weight should be 189.54 to barely be considered "fit", this means I need to lose 114lbs.

What's got me here? My major problem here is alcohol. Anywhere between 4 to 7 nights a week I'll drink either 3x 22oz IPA beers (400-500 calories each) or a half bottle of whiskey (at 110 calories per shot, this is close to 1000 calories). Lot's of people get here by drinking soda, well at least I get to ruin my kidneys at the same time. On a slow week this means a minimum of an extra 4000 calories per week, if I go on a binge this could be over 10,000 calories per week. Just from alcohol. Amazing, right? Every week I do this to myself, and it's usually a lot closer to the higher end. I'm not here to make excuses, the reality is that I'm a functional (for now) alcoholic and it's killing me.

After that I do eat more than I should probably, and I need to move more. Calories in, calories out...

What's my plan? The main plan this week is to not drink, secondary is to work out 3x this week to get my body ready for a lifting routine. This isn't new to me, I've been able to lift good weight in the past. Pretty simple, don't go crazy but get ready for all of this. Also don't consume an extra 10k calories.

What's my long term plan? I've got what you'd call an addictive personality. I'm addicted to alcohol, I'm addicted to nicotine, I'm addicted to coffee, I've been addicted to drugs, but what I'm most addicted to is my structure and routine. My plan here is to change my routine and addictions, I've got timers set on my phone for when I need to wake up, when I need to work out in the morning, and when I need to work out in the evening. If I can successfully change my routine this will turn out well. I'm not the OCD person where I need everything to be in order or anything, but I'm certainly the type that if it's time to do something I just do it without thinking.

There it is. Here's to 2016!

Political filters, laws, and prohibitions legitimately apply to political beliefs, and in this case the key term is "political islam".
